items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: we took Vidal Bolado, our conga player, to Miami where there was Mangual, Vidal, Uba, Andino and Rene Hernandez.

ctx.x: .... as a matter of fact, he started in La Conga, 1944, late '44, with us and we took Vidal Bolado, our conga player, to Miami where there was Mangual, Vidal, Uba, Andino and Rene Hernandez.
Okay, so then that's the first time you had a conga.
